correctness.rationale: Fenchel support dual yields f*=||b||²/2-dist(b,C)²/[2(1+r)] and x_kappa=(kappa b-Proj_C(kappa b))/(kappa+r). The projection normal inequality p.q>=0 and factorization B²-D(r+kappa²)=kappa²(1-kappa)² imply the exact nonnegative gap (A/D)L-f(x_kappa)=(1-kappa)²(B p.q+r||q||²/2)/(D B²). A farthest nonzero point p of C certifies equality at b=p/kappa for every gauge. Contractive proximal iteration and q>0 bounds are proved separately. 1,728 exact rational cases independently checked the algebra.

value.rationale: Sharp dimension-free worst-case unweighted objective inflation quantifies the exact cost of the weighted-gradient objective mismatch highlighted in the motivating 2026 method. The factor is nontrivially independent of arbitrary support-set geometry, and every fixed nonzero gauge attains it. Positive ridge changes the exact worst-case severity, making this a benchmark for objective calibration and regularizer scaling rather than a textbook single soft-threshold computation.
